topics.title: USSF-259 SUCCESS — Falcon 9 Wed Sep 16 8:08pm CT
topics.why: Classified USSF-259 launched from Vandenberg SLC-4E after a one-day scrub; B1097 13th flight, OCISLY recovery; SpaceX confirmed payload to orbit early Thu CT.
